mira: Heads-up: we still have three incompatible sources of truth for quant profiles (model team, runtime blob, ops S3). This is blocking a clean canary for fp8/int8 mixes. Thoughts?

sam: We should pick one canonical workflow. My vote: author in git, CI emits signed artifacts to S3. Runtime reads S3 but validates signature against the git tag. Keeps auditability and gives ops speed.

mira: Same direction. Two followups: (1) required metadata fields for observability/rollbacks, (2) what exact fallback behavior runtime must take when a profile is incompatible.

noah: For metadata, propose: profile_name, profile_hash, expected_quality_delta, calibration_dataset_hash, ops_blacklist (flat strings), created_by, release_tag, created_at. Keep everything string/array-of-strings.

ops-bot: FYI: canary pattern we've used: shadow-apply, 5% traffic, 25%, 100% with automated rollback triggers. See runbook link in ops.

sam: For enforcement: runtime should do an O(1) preflight: check profile signature/hash, then a tiny compatibility map lookup (model_uuid + hardware_path -> compatible boolean). If incompatible => immediate reject and fallback to fp16 path. No prolonged reconcile.

mira: Agreed. Also need concrete regression thresholds so SRE/QA have actionable triggers. Proposed defaults: quality: LL delta > 0.02 on calibration set -> alert; human-failure-rate > 1% -> strong alert. Latency + memory: latency increase > 30% or memory > 20% -> auto-fallback.

noah: Add nuance: cost-only increases (more tokens due to longer decoding) should create billing alerts but not auto-rollback. Customers can opt into stricter gates.

anya: Private installs note: runtime might not fetch S3. We should include a signed tarball in release so operators can stage locally; runtime still verifies signatures before applying.

mira: API shape idea: /profiles/{model}/{version}/meta returns a tiny JSON-like flat map (name, hash, expected_quality_delta, ops_blacklist[], calibration_hash, release_tag, created_by). Runtime caches minimal fields.

sam: Implementation nit: ops_blacklist must be normalized tokens (no nested objects) for quick runtime lookup. Consider also a compact bitmask per-hardware to avoid string parsing on older runtimes.

noah: Observability: include sample_prompts list and calibration_sample_hash so we can surface canonical examples in traces. Also add a quick "canary_tag" field to mark cohorts.

mira: Ok action items: I'll write a short RFC capturing artifact lifecycle, manifest schema, API contract, and rollback thresholds. Ops: draft runbook for distribution/fallback. Runtime: implement preflight and the compact compat bitmap.

ops-bot: Action items created: #QPROF-901 (RFC), #OPS-404 (runbook), #RT-912 (preflight bitmap).

sam: I'll prototype the preflight today if we agree on the manifest schema.

anya: I'll add a ticket for private deployment signing + local staging docs.

mira: Thanks. Let's keep the manifest strictly flat and small so verifiers in constrained envs can do quick checks. Will open RFC by EOD Thursday.
